title: Website Performance Metrics
narration: This chart highlights key metrics demonstrating a website’s effectiveness in driving local business.  Specifically, Google Business Profile engagement has increased by 35% year over year, indicating improved local visibility. Furthermore, a streamlined contact form can boost lead generation by up to 15%, while a consistent 92% of calls originate from website visits. These figures underscore the importance of tracking and optimizing your online presence for tangible results.
